policy_text: Passengers are permitted to bring one carry-on bag and one personal item, such as a purse or laptop bag, on board the aircraft. The carry-on bag must fit within the specified dimensions, typically 22 x 14 x 9 inches, to ensure it can be stored in the overhead compartment or under the seat in front of the passenger. Additionally, the airline may have weight restrictions for carry-on bags to ensure the safety of passengers and crew. It is important for passengers to review the specific carry-on baggage policy of the airline they are traveling with to avoid any issues at the airport. Some airlines may also have restrictions on certain items that can be brought in the carry-on bag, such as liquids, sharp objects, or flammable materials. It is recommended to review the prohibited items list provided by the airline before packing the carry-on bag to avoid any inconvenience at the security checkpoint. It is important for passengers to comply with the carry-on baggage policy to ensure a smooth and efficient boarding process for everyone on board.

Passengers are allowed to bring one piece of carry-on baggage on board, with specified size and weight restrictions. The carry-on baggage should be stowed in the overhead compartments or under the seat in front of the passenger. This policy aims to ensure the safety and comfort of all passengers and crew members. The maximum dimensions for carry-on baggage are typically 22 x 14 x 9 inches (56 x 36 x 23 cm), and the maximum weight allowance is usually around 15-20 pounds (7-9 kg). It's important for passengers to adhere to these guidelines to avoid delays during the boarding process and to maintain an organized cabin environment. Additionally, certain items such as liquids, gels, and sharp objects may be subject to additional restrictions and should be packed in accordance with the airline's policy. Understanding and following the carry-on baggage policy helps to streamline the travel experience for everyone involved.

Passengers are allowed to carry one piece of carry-on baggage with dimensions not exceeding 22 x 14 x 9 inches. The carry-on bag should not weigh more than 15 pounds. This allowance may vary for international flights, so passengers are advised to check the specific requirements for their destination. Additionally, certain items such as liquids, gels, and aerosols must be in containers of 3.4 ounces or less and must be placed in a quart-sized, clear, plastic, zip-top bag. Passengers are permitted to bring one bag of this size through the security checkpoint. The carry-on bag should easily fit in the overhead bin or under the seat in front of the passenger. Any item larger than the sizing requirements or exceeding the weight limit will need to be checked in as hold baggage. It is the responsibility of the passenger to ensure that their carry-on baggage complies with the airline's policy to avoid any inconvenience during the boarding process.
